title: Zesty Syrian Red Cabbage Stew
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring red cabbage, this stew is a festive and flavorful meal, made with a variety of spices and cooked to perfection using the sous-vide method.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, melt the ghee over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shredded red cabbage to the pan and cook until it is slightly wilted.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a sous-vide bag and seal the bag.
Place the bag in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the bag from the machine and stir in the lemon juice.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
